title: 房价百分比
problem_statement_md:
给定一个代表房价的数组。

假设房价平均值`mean`，房价标准差`std`，请计算房价在`[mean-std, mean+std]`范围内的房屋数量，并输出百分占比。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]House Prices[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given an array that represents house prices. 
Calculate and output the percentage of houses that are within [b]one standard deviation from the mean[/b].
[note]To calculate the percentage, divide the number of houses that satisfy the condition by the total number of houses, and multiply the result by 100.[/note]
hint_md: 为了计算百分比，用满足条件的房屋数量除以房屋总数，然后将结果乘以100。

code_templates.solution_code:
import numpy as np

data = np.array([150000, 125000, 320000, 540000, 200000, 120000, 160000, 230000, 280000, 290000, 300000, 500000, 420000, 100000, 150000, 280000])

data_mean = np.mean(data)
data_std = np.std(data)

p = sum((data_mean-data_std <=data) & (data <= data_mean + data_std))/len(data) * 100

print(p)
